newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ says does not need to securitise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ says does not need to securitise.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) chief executive Don Mercer said on Friday the bank had no need to securitise its Australian retail loan portfolio.
"Our analysis at the moment is that we are better off holding retail assets on our book rather than securitisation," Mercer told a media briefing.
ANZ's net loans after provisions for doubtful debts totalled A$75.9 billion at September 30.
Mercer said the bank's attitude toward securitisation might change if it had to raise more equity in order to fund its loan book.
"But at the moment we're comfortable for equity," he added.
ANZ on Wednesday posted a net profit for the year to September 30 of A$1.12 billion, six percent higher than a year ago.
At 0215 GMT (1.15 p.m.) ANZ shares were up six cents at A$7.84.
